title: AccessPointRouteChangedPayload
description: Payload of the AccessPointRouteChanged event (model/architecture/events.yaml; class: domain; owner rulings INV-Q-4872 and INV-Q-4993). Emitted when the elected acknowledgement route of an AP connection, or the entity refs assigned to it, change. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

connectionRef.description: The AP connection the change concerns.

acknowledgementRoute.description: The elected acknowledgement route (INV-REQ-1310). Absent when the route is cleared (no route elected).

entityRefs.description: The whole list of entity refs assigned to the connection after the change; may be empty.

version.description: Per-connection version; rises by one on every change of the route or of the entity refs.
